sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a ball on an inclined ramp (or a
spring-loaded launcher). Bars on the side: E_p (gravitational,
= m·g·h), E_c (kinetic, = ½·m·v²), E_m = E_p + E_c (constant when
no friction). Ticker runs a simple sim; student drags the ball to
any starting height, sets slider m, releases. Bars swap values as
ball slides down (E_p ↓, E_c ↑) with E_m flat. Experiment: pick
starting h so ball reaches a target speed at the bottom. Evaluate:
bars hidden — student computes v at bottom via mgh = ½mv² and enters
value. Wrinkle: E_p reference = ground level; g = 10 m/s² for 2ème.
